answer: Like a quartz lattice resisting fracturing, decentralized reputation crystallizes across an interconnected meadow of agent interactions. To resist Sybil attacks, the network binds voting weight to transitively validated trust graphs, where forging multiple synthetic identities incurs an exponential cost in stake and time. Sybils cast against genuine consensus remain isolated, dark and inert as raw onyx, unable to sway the self-reinforcing crystal matrix.
